technical-summary: rad0029 skipped worlds where the cheaper-rank re-split had run; the launcher's manifests select --placement expert_tiered, so layouts never got the own split. In a dense world that re-split frees nothing, so rad0029 now replaces it. qwen27b-tp3-capacity from the launcher: 993,536 -> 1,743,616 tokens (3.8 -> 6.7 sessions at 262k).
user-summary-candidate: The larger three-card KV cache now also applies when serving starts from a layout.
